fields.statement: At 07af60a2 I ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/daemon-install$ -count=1: PASS. The script sets PATH=$WORK/bin:... and TMPDIR='$WORK/tmp dir' (a space), installs, and greps Environment="PATH=...bin..." and Environment="TMPDIR=.../tmp dir" beside ExecStart=... daemon --autonomous; a second install prints 'nothing changed', leaves the unit byte-identical and runs no daemon-reload; a changed PATH ($WORK/extra) prints Installed, rewrites the unit and calls daemon-reload. The diff puts the Environment= lines between WorkingDirectory= and ExecStart=, from ctxGetenv. I also built the binary and ran daemon install in a scratch repo with fake systemctl/loginctl and PATH holding a double quote, a percent, a dollar and a backslash: the unit read Environment="PATH=.../odd\"q%%p$X\\b:..." and Environment="TMPDIR=.../t dir", the whole NAME=value in double quotes with \ and " escaped, % doubled and $ left as is, as systemd reads Environment=. go vet and gofmt are clean on the changed packages.
